prompt:
Create a finished illustration for a public book-summary library for adult readers. Use a calm, contemporary illustrated-book style: hand-painted gouache, soft matte pigment, restrained pencil details, and a subtle warm ivory paper texture. Use a consistent palette of muted sage and olive green, warm ochre, natural wood brown, and warm ivory, with dark brown or charcoal details. Keep saturation restrained and lighting soft and natural. Give the scene generous breathing room, a clear focal point, and simple, recognizable forms that remain readable on a phone. When people are relevant, depict believable adults with natural proportions, respectful expressions, and ordinary clothing. Use the same medium, palette, texture, and level of detail across the illustration. Avoid photorealism, glossy 3D, neon colors, cinematic effects, heavy black outlines, childish clipart, ornamental clutter, and a different art style in each panel. No readable text, captions, logos, watermarks, fake book covers, or invented author portraits. Keep all explanations and essential labels outside the generated image.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square book-summary hero, 1024 by 1024 pixels. Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its gouache medium, muted palette, paper texture, gentle light and visual density; do not repeat its person, desk or setting. Create a new conceptual scene about coordinating software construction for The Mythical Man-Month. Three adult software designers stand around a waist-high open wooden architectural model of a single coherent structure: several sage and ochre modular sections must fit together, with one central joint still unfinished. One designer studies that joint while a second offers a new module and a third compares an ivory plan sheet bearing only a few abstract geometric shapes, no text. Show how shared design and fitting the parts together require care, rather than merely adding more hands. Ordinary clothing, believable anatomy, restrained expressions, uncluttered studio, no computers necessary. Balanced square composition, modest overhead three-quarter viewpoint, generous breathing room, central model and people kept safely within the edges. This is an illustrative metaphor, not an actual event or a portrait of Brooks.
